page0.text:
"I'm home... Wait, huh? Is Fuji-nee already back?"
I take off my shoes and enter the hallway.
It's not even 6:00 PM yet, so why is the kyudo club advisor back so early?

page1.text:
"Welcome home, Shirou."
"...Mrgh. There you are, you little nincompoop."
Saber greets me while seated in a polite seiza posture, while Fuji-nee is very improperly resting her face on the coffee table.

page2.text:
...
There's a shadow of defeat in my adoptive guardian's eyes.
I'm curious as to why, but experience tells me it's probably no big deal.

page3.text:
"Sorry I'm late. Did anything weird happen while I was out, Saber?"
"Nothing in particular. What about you, Shirou? Was there anything of note at school?"

page4.text:
"Nothing on my end, either. Shinji didn't show up and school was business as usual. I think we can cross him off our list of people to watch for now..."
Using roundabout language, I report to Saber that there are no other Masters at school.

page5.text:
"Hmm. Something reeks. This bittersweet post-rainshower aroma, like a 10,000-yen bill you hid on payday but can't remember where you put it, is, without a doubt, the stench of secrets!"
She sniffs the air like a dog off its leash.

page6.text:
"I smell rusty shackles on you, Shirou. How very shady.
Are you hiding something from your big sister?"
"Oh, wow."
I don't believe it.
How is she this hammered so early in the day?

page7.text:
"...Saber. What happened to Fuji-nee? The tiger doesn't get this drunk unless something really crazy happens."
"Er...I'm not sure. I thought Taiga might be feeling out of sorts because she's hungry."
Saber says something terribly cutting, and with such ease.

page8.text:
"That's a load of crap! Saber, you said you wanted to see my skills and then you beat me to a pulp!"
Fuji-nee pounds the table.

page9.text:
...Whether out of frustration or fear, she scurries behind me and loudly boos Saber in protest.
Also, she sure is acting all buddy-buddy with Saber real fast.

page10.text:
"Saber...did you spar with Fuji-nee?"
"Ah...well, I suggested that Taiga get some exercise if she had free time. It was a mock duel with bamboo swords for safety, and she consented, so—"

page11.text:
"Don't believe her lies, Shirou. Saber came after me with murder in her eyes. I can tell. I know guys with guns.
She meant to kill me. I'm absolutely, positively sure! She pounded me flat as soon as I let my guard down..."

page12.text:
Fuji-nee trembles.
"Saber. Did you..."
Did you fight Fuji-nee like you really meant it...?

page13.text:
"Eh...? Well, I may have been a little enthusiastic.
I was tired of waiting for you to come home, and Taiga's skills were greater than expected, so perhaps I just acted on instinct..."
Wow. That sounds terrifying.
Fuji-nee reached an impressive 5-dan in kendo at her age, but Saber's on a completely different level.

page14.text:
"A-anyway, don’t go sneaking into Saber’s room at night or in the morning if you value your life!
Hell will be unleashed upon this world if you make a move on her! You will be wiped off the face of the Earth and won't even have a corpse left to collect!"
"...Hmm."

page15.text:
She's right.
I still have another problem to deal with.
What do I do with Saber, who insists on sleeping in the same room as me?
I'm a growing young man, and I have...issues with a girl like Saber sleeping in the same room.

page16.text: "You needn't concern yourself with that, Taiga. I serve at Shirou's command. I would never raise a hand against him."

page17.text:
"Hm? Hmm? You serve... What was that, Saber?"
"Think nothing of it. More importantly, to avoid any misunderstandings, I would inform you that I will be retiring to Shirou's chambers tonight."
...
Fuji-nee freezes in her tracks.

page18.text:
"..."
Oh no...
Given how we're positioned and the power balance between us, she's definitely gonna do it...

page19.text:
"Fuji-nee. Actually, I've been hiding something from you since yesterday."
I hear Fuji-nee from behind me.
"Hup."
Wow. She's totally ignoring me, and I just heard a sound like a phone book being slammed on a table.

page20.text:
"Listen to me.
Saber doesn't understand Japanese."
"Ready, and..."
Ah, there it is:
the sensation of being put in a sleeper choke hold from behind.
Fuji-nee doesn't know how to hold back her own strength, so when she has me by the neck, I'm in serious danger—

page21.text:
"Wait, this is not the time for that! Hey! F-Fuji-nee, you win! I give up, so—ow, I'm really gonna fall!"
Crack. Crack.
Fuji-nee's answer is to grapple me harder in a magnificent grinding of bone and flesh.

page22.text:
"Uwagh, I give, I give! Stop it! And don't throw me next!"
In my fading consciousness, I manage to tap Fuji-nee's arm.
However...

page23.text:
"Aw, shaddup! Eat dirt, you lazy son! That's not how I raised you! Waaahhh!!!"
Ah, I'm going down.
Damn, just...one problem after another...

page24.text:
"Jeez, that was awful."
My neck makes cracking noises.
Bent nearly at a right angle, I managed to get off with only bruises thanks to my daily training.

page25.text: "Ugh, how disappointing... I thought I could twist and let you go down into a roll, but you're heavier than I thought. It took everything I had just to throw you."

page26.text:
"Obviously. I'm not a little kid anymore, you know. Stop trying to suplex me with those skinny arms. You could've hurt yourself."
"...I've learned my lesson."

page27.text:
"You too, Saber. We're sleeping in adjacent rooms, not the same room."
"Mmm... But it's to protect you, Shirou."

page28.text:
"You're protecting me plenty already. I wouldn't know what to do with myself if we stayed in the same bedroom. I'm sorry, but this is the best I can do. It's a hill I have to die on."
"Mmrgh... You're asking a lot."

page29.text:
"As long as both of you understand...All right, time to get ready for dinner."
I stand up, stretching my neck.

page30.text:
"Oh right, Fuji-nee.
I'm thinking of having Sakura stay over starting today. Is that okay? I'll put her in the guesthouse that we gave Saber before."
"Sakura's staying over? That's fine with me, but why the sudden change of heart? You're acting kind of weird lately."

page31.text: "...Well, Sakura doesn't look like she's feeling well lately. It's probably because Shinji's never home. She should have someone around to look after her."

page32.text: "Mmhmm... Okay. And have you told Sakura yet? At club today, she looked no worse for wear."

page33.text:
"But she's going to—I mean, what about you and club? Why are you back so early today?"
"Hm? Oh, someone got hurt. I let Mitsuzuri take care of it, and then I came straight here after sending the students home."

page34.text:
...Something like that happened, huh?
It's a little concerning to hear that someone got injured at club, but Fuji-nee wouldn't be here if it was serious.
Someone probably just jammed their finger or got anemic.

page35.text:
...
Anyway, this is my chance.
Sakura's like family to both me and Fuji-nee.
Then, I should...
